adjudication.rationale: In `TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve`, when `SiteSetting.feed_polling_enabled?` is true it calls `Jobs::PollFeed.new.execute({})` synchronously (see `lib/topic_retriever.rb`) before falling back to HTTP fetch. `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` parses the configured feed and iterates `rss.items.each` importing each item (`app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb`). This is a real design/performance concern introduced by the diff: an embed request can trigger a full feed parse/import attempt and tightly couples the retriever to the scheduled job implementation, and the per-URL throttle (`retrieved:#{@embed_url}`) doesn't prevent repeated full-feed work across different embed URLs.
